verdict.rationale: Jan lets users import existing local GGUF files directly (jan-docs-10) and search/download models from Hugging Face (jan-docs-11), implying some reuse of already-downloaded model files rather than mandatory re-download. However there is no explicit documentation on cache directory structure, compatibility with other runtimes' caches (e.g., Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp cache reuse), or guarantees against re-conversion. missing for 10: explicit cache/format interoperability docs, cross-runtime reuse confirmation, independent verification of no re-conversion needed.
